system.description:
Malfeas does not merely endure strikes against his body — he punishes the insolence of those who dare raise arms against the King of Chaos. When an attacker fails to penetrate the Infernal's defenses, the Infernal may reflexively strike back with a burst of green-sun fury. This charm activates after a successful parry or dodge, immediately granting a free counterattack against the attacker using (Dexterity + Melee) that does not count against the Infernal's actions for the tick.

The counterattack carries the full weight of Malfeas' disdain, adding the Infernal's Essence in bonus dice to the roll. Enemies who trigger this rebuke suffer a penalty equal to the Infernal's Essence on their next action, shaken by the sudden reversal of fortune. The Counterattack keyword means this charm cannot be used in the same action as another Counterattack charm.
